name: webmcp-daemon
description: Lets Claude Code see and operate web pages that expose WebMCP tools: runs the local webmcp-daemon, connects to it over MCP, and injects each page's instructions and live UI state.

inject_page_context.title: Inject page context into terminal sessions
inject_page_context.description: When on, a connected page's instructions are added at session start and its UI state with every prompt. Turn off if you only use the chat in the browser.
